hero.title: Human systems are art.
hero.subtitle: PeopleArt trains enterprise teams to master leadership, strategy, teamwork, marketing, innovation, and education — each as an artistic discipline.

concept.title: Every human system is an artistic act.
concept.body: Leadership is conducting. Strategy is composing. Teams are choreographies. Products are sculptures. Campaigns are paintings. Education is direction. PeopleArt transforms how enterprises operate by treating human interaction as a craft — with the precision, beauty, and mastery of the arts.

archetypes.title: The Six Artistic Archetypes
archetypes.subtitle: Six frameworks, each mapping a core business discipline to an art form — giving enterprises a language for mastery.

science.title: Grounded in Behavioral Science
science.body: Our methodology is built on the science of Propiología — a behavioral framework combining AI, biometrics, and narrative psychology. Every archetype has a measurable behavioral foundation.
